candidate.claim: listitem prepends checkbox HTML directly onto token text without guard, so rendering the same tokens twice prepends the checkbox twice and re-escapes already-mutated text
candidate.title: Task list render mutates tokens causing duplicate checkbox

verifier.reason: Renderer.ts:81-84 unconditionally assigns checkbox-prefixed text back onto item.tokens[0].text and checkbox plus escape() onto its first text child while setting escaped=true, with no guard against already-prefixed or already-escaped text, so a second render of the same tokens reapplies both mutations.

candidate.claim: Lexer constructor reuses options.tokenizer instance and overwrites its options/lexer/rules, so creating a second lexer with shared options corrupts the first lexer's tokenizer
candidate.title: Shared tokenizer lexer pointer overwritten

verifier.reason: Lexer.ts:27-30 reuses options.tokenizer without cloning and overwrites tokenizer.options and tokenizer.lexer, and Lexer.ts:55 overwrites tokenizer.rules, so a second _Lexer sharing the same options mutates the first lexer's shared tokenizer.

candidate.claim: Parser constructor reuses options.renderer instance and overwrites its options/parser, so creating a second parser with shared options corrupts the first parser's renderer
candidate.title: Shared renderer parser pointer overwritten

verifier.reason: The constructor at Parser.ts:16-19 reuses options.renderer without cloning and mutates that shared instance's options and parser fields to the newest parser, so a second _Parser sharing the renderer/options leaves the first parser's renderer pointing at the second parser.

candidate.claim: parseMarkdown mutates shared opt.hooks object block/options fields, so a second parse overwrites the hooks state used by the first parse
candidate.title: Shared hooks object mutated per parse

verifier.reason: Confirmed: Instance.ts:273-274 creates only a shallow copy of options so opt.hooks aliases the shared defaults/passed hooks object, Instance.ts:292-295 mutates that object's options and block fields, and the async path at Instance.ts:300-307 defers processAllTokens/postprocess calls, allowing a concurrent second parse to overwrite state the first parse's hooks can read via Hooks.ts:8-9 and Hooks.ts:45-54.

candidate.claim: outputLink unconditionally sets inLink true then false instead of saving/restoring prior value, so nested link tokenization leaves outer link state incorrectly false
candidate.title: Link inLink state not saved and restored

verifier.reason: Tokenizer.ts:17 unconditionally sets lexer.state.inLink = true before lexer.inlineTokens(text) at Tokenizer.ts:24, and Tokenizer.ts:26 unconditionally sets it to false with no saved prior value, so a re-entrant outputLink call for a nested link/image token will clear the outer link's state.

verifier.reason: Tokens.List has no text property at Tokens.ts:138-145 while Tokens.Blockquote does at Tokens.ts:32-37, so the list branch at Tokenizer.ts:215 cannot use oldToken.text/newToken.text; the list token parsed from currentText at Tokenizer.ts:184 contributes its raw to the stripped text accumulator, making raw-based trimming/appending correct rather than corrupting.
